scope.runProtocol: All 40 original development prompts, one warmed application, shared 30-second deadline after setup. Automatic/v2+automatic-fit/v2. Isolated store with no real user data. Refreshed public graph from87 explicit development artist IDs plus provider neighbors;2 invalid radio batches omitted with receipts. Store reused after diagnostics; not a cold-provider or paired cache-condition gate. No concurrent native workload. Installed encoder/pack remain incompatible and are never mixed.

methodology.rubrics: Original baseline rubrics copied verbatim; inherited familiarity disclosed. Every actual occurrence assessed against its actual prompt, not the engine fit label.
methodology.grading: good=credible central fit; partial=related with a material unmet/unverified aspect; mismatch=credible musical conflict; unknown=insufficient evidence. Missing slots are separate.
methodology.blinding: Musical judgments drafted from identity-only lists and sources before inspecting engine scores where practical. Receipt validation occurred afterward.
methodology.identity: Catalog identity and precise ordered occurrence matched to authoritative run and listening sidecar. Declared MBID/ISRC are not automatically web verified; exact master uncertainty remains explicit.
methodology.sourceScope: Artist/label/publisher and first-hand criticism preferred; community, secondary, indexed and album-level limits disclosed. No audio played.
methodology.timing: Single warmed process; no per-case supervised child reports. The completed raw report and ordered sidecar are authoritative; this is not a cold-start or paired-cache test.
